dumont_2.source: Offset (+0.45 km E, +0.25 km N) from GNIS Dumont Dunes centre; on dune per 3DEP hillshade and USGS imagery (results/v1_dumont_extra_check.png)

dumont_3.source: Offset (-0.40 km E, -0.22 km N) from GNIS Dumont Dunes centre; moved from (-0.10,-0.45) before any computation because that box hung off the dune margin; on dune per hillshade

kelso.source: Kelso Dunes, TopoQuest GNIS-derived summit record (NAD83) https://topoquest.com/place-detail.php?id=1660830 ; Wikipedia 34 54 13 N 115 43 05 W agrees

mesquite.source: Mesquite Flat Sand Dunes, TopoZone https://www.topozone.com/california/inyo-ca/flat/mesquite-flat-4/ ; Hikespeak trailhead 36.6062,-117.115 within 1 km

coverage: All five centres have USGS 3DEP 1 m (project CA_FEMAR9Southeast_D24) per TNM Access API
visual_check: results/v1_site_hillshade_check.png, results/v1_site_imagery_check.png, results/v1_dumont_extra_check.png: all centres on dune morphology
procedure: Each positive is the query in turn; rank all other 68 patches by distance; record ranks of the other 4 positives (20 ranks total).
features_and_metric: Method A exactly as Gate 2 (23 features, z-score Euclidean); z-score mean/std computed over all 69 patches. Method B = Gate 2 DINOv2 cosine, reported too.
criterion: PASS if the median of the 20 'other positive' ranks under Method A <= top 10% of the 68-item ranked list: ceil(0.10*68)=7 (also reported against floor = 6).
secondary_variant: Same, also counting the GNIS Dumont candidate as a positive target (reported, not the criterion).
note: Two of the five positives (dumont_2, dumont_3) share a dune field with each other and with the GNIS Dumont candidate; per-pair ranks are reported so within-field and cross-field retrieval can be told apart.
